definition: Preserve content and uncertainty; choose interventions by task value; propagate a joint distribution with continuous first-passage, survival and regenerative operators; connect layers with content distributions and event statistics.
runtime: NumPy 2.3.5 / SciPy 1.17.0 CPU implementation. PyTorch and Rust are unavailable in this execution environment. Forward-mode derivatives and manual recurrent backpropagation are implemented and independently checked; this is an explicit implementation deviation from the upstream requirements.txt, not a claim to have run PyTorch or production Rust.
finite_generator: Centered nonnegative nearest-neighbour rates on the declared parameter box, reflecting upper boundary, absorbing lower boundary into explicit Erlang recovery. Matrix exponentials are exact up to numerical error for this declared finite model only.
reset_extension: RESET costs 0.04, consumes the next actual interval, first maps all states to recovery phase 0 preserving the current bit, then applies the same transition. It restarts recovery even if already recovering. Content retention is applied once, on recovery completion. This adds an explicit intervention to the upstream synthetic task and is not a proof of HX optimality.
observation_order: WAIT advances time without observation. READ advances time then receives the endpoint symbol. RESET advances time after the reset map without observation. State-dependent actual fees are hidden from the actor until episode completion.
public_clock: The remaining interval schedule is public and independent of hidden state and symbol draws; all actors receive the same remaining schedule. Future observations and unread symbols remain private.
confirmation_seeds: IID sequences fit_seed+7000000, OOD sequences fit_seed+8000000; IID episode tapes fit_seed+9000000, OOD tapes fit_seed+10000000. These namespaces are generated only after candidate freeze.
training_reset_extension: The additional reset action appears in training, with its public action indicator. All three cores receive exactly the same raw sequences and labels.
input: 10 coordinates: seven symbol one-hots, observed mask, physical dt, public reset indicator. No latent state, future symbol, unread symbol or teacher posterior is supplied at inference.
training_loss: Mean causal joint-posterior cross entropy plus 0.25 times current-bit label cross entropy, across all sequence steps. Teacher is used only in training and validation scoring.
initialization: Seeded perturbation of bounded raw physical parameters and small random emission logits; true emissions are not supplied to the fitted HX cell.
optimizer: Adam, beta=(0.9,0.999), epsilon=1e-8; gradient norm cap 5; learning rate HX 0.03, GRU and continuous diagonal SSM 0.01; hidden widths GRU 16 and SSM 24.
validation: Validation joint-posterior CE at construction and every 10 updates. Keep the minimum-CE checkpoint seen within the measured 20 CPU second budget; always retain raw history, final checkpoint and all failures. No accuracy-based early stopping. Batch order is a seed-fixed repeated permutation shared across cores.
ordinary_dual_and_matched_slope: Mechanism references evaluate ordinary independent heads and margin-only slope-matched channels; these references do not replace the preregistered stronger GRU/SSM primary comparator.
controller: Exact finite-horizon belief DP with shared fitted Q/E/payoff/cost/R, using each core's causal belief. The planner's future Bayes continuation is a shared declared model-based plan; realized ordinary recurrent updates may differ. Report actual policy rollout utility; do not claim its Bellman value is the ordinary deployed policy's Q-pi.
native_scope: Independent C uniformization audit for the exported finite transition. Production Rust ownership and pure-FP32 full-HX admission remain separate gates.
additional_predeclared_mechanism_slices: Same active mean with different spread; same active margin with different content uncertainty; remaining intervals; recovery probability. Report value changes and optimal actions including cases with no optimal voluntary RESET. Do not tune costs to obtain reset usage.
cost: Report common data/teacher CPU, every fit's CPU and overshoot, all validation/core selection CPU, inference/controller/owner CPU, amortized training at 1000 episodes, and measured process wall time. CPU time is not energy. The ordinary development path includes both candidate fits.
heldout_policy: Source, protocol, raw training artifacts and per-seed ordinary selection are committed and hashed before confirmation generation. Source fixes after confirmation invalidate confirmatory labels and require a fresh separately recorded holdout namespace; original outputs remain.
